purpose: Canonical lifecycle states from dream/source observation through preservation, review, claim, display, correction, and rollback.

states.label: Speculative dream, telos statement, open horizon, or possible future capability
states.definition: Speculative dream, telos statement, open horizon, or possible future capability. It is not a plan, data record, or claim.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A selected route, design note, policy sketch, branch decision, or method proposal
states.definition: A selected route, design note, policy sketch, branch decision, or method proposal. It can shape work but cannot prove facts.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A family of possible public-record carriers, such as DOJ SLS, court dockets, POST lists, union contracts, FOIA releases, or settlement ledgers
states.definition: A family of possible public-record carriers, such as DOJ SLS, court dockets, POST lists, union contracts, FOIA releases, or settlement ledgers.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A specific source owner or carrier type that may hold records
states.definition: A specific source owner or carrier type that may hold records. It is not evidence that an event happened.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A row or entry observed in a source carrier
states.definition: A row or entry observed in a source carrier. It is a source observation, not a misconduct or status claim.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A source-scoped matter, agency, entity, or object candidate
states.definition: A source-scoped matter, agency, entity, or object candidate. It is not a canonical agency, officer, person, or incident record.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A document label or link label seen on a carrier
states.definition: A document label or link label seen on a carrier. It says a label exists, not what the document content proves.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A URL or link target has been observed or resolved
states.definition: A URL or link target has been observed or resolved. It is not preservation and not content review.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A capture envelope or intake wrapper exists for a source target
states.definition: A capture envelope or intake wrapper exists for a source target. It is not the source payload.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A target is ordered or ready for private capture
states.definition: A target is ordered or ready for private capture. No payload content or hash is admitted at this state.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A private payload has been captured under custody controls
states.definition: A private payload has been captured under custody controls. It remains nonpublic and cannot yet support claims.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A digest, checksum, WARC/WACZ sidecar, or equivalent fixity receipt exists for a private payload
states.definition: A digest, checksum, WARC/WACZ sidecar, or equivalent fixity receipt exists for a private payload.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A privacy/harm preflight has reviewed whether extraction, summary, display, or redaction is permissible
states.definition: A privacy/harm preflight has reviewed whether extraction, summary, display, or redaction is permissible.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A bounded extractive action has been permitted after custody and privacy gates
states.definition: A bounded extractive action has been permitted after custody and privacy gates. This is permission, not an extracted claim.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A draft bounded summary exists and awaits review for accuracy, scope, privacy, and due process
states.definition: A draft bounded summary exists and awaits review for accuracy, scope, privacy, and due process.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A source-bound evidence atom or document-effect atom has been extracted and remains bounded to its carrier and review state
states.definition: A source-bound evidence atom or document-effect atom has been extracted and remains bounded to its carrier and review state.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A proposed claim is explicit, typed, source-bound, and awaiting evidence, defeater, privacy, and due-process review
states.definition: A proposed claim is explicit, typed, source-bound, and awaiting evidence, defeater, privacy, and due-process review.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A claim candidate has completed review checks but is not necessarily admitted or displayed
states.definition: A claim candidate has completed review checks but is not necessarily admitted or displayed.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A reviewed claim is admitted for internal/private corpus use with rollback dependencies and correction obligations
states.definition: A reviewed claim is admitted for internal/private corpus use with rollback dependencies and correction obligations.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A display unit or page module is proposed from admitted private claims or nonclaim inventory, but is not public
states.definition: A display unit or page module is proposed from admitted private claims or nonclaim inventory, but is not public.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A display has passed public-display review, redaction, freshness, and role/access checks
states.definition: A display has passed public-display review, redaction, freshness, and role/access checks.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A public surface is published and carries update, correction, and rollback obligations
states.definition: A public surface is published and carries update, correction, and rollback obligations.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A correction, right-of-reply, appeal, or contested-record input has been received and must be routed
states.definition: A correction, right-of-reply, appeal, or contested-record input has been received and must be routed.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A contradiction, stale-source signal, privacy red flag, legal-order change, or correction has triggered rollback review
states.definition: A contradiction, stale-source signal, privacy red flag, legal-order change, or correction has triggered rollback review.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: A record or display has been retired, superseded, redacted, or archived after a new state or review decision
states.definition: A record or display has been retired, superseded, redacted, or archived after a new state or review decision.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: Reentry, office, audit, route, and program scaffolding that governs work but is not evidence or claim material
states.definition: Reentry, office, audit, route, and program scaffolding that governs work but is not evidence or claim material.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.

states.label: Validation, file audit, schema audit, line digest, factor map, and release checks
states.definition: Validation, file audit, schema audit, line digest, factor map, and release checks. These are release controls, not data claims.
states.notes: Rev0017 defines the state; it does not promote existing records into live public claims.
